W2.1 ensemble (experiments/w2_ensemble.py), combiner=rule_only, budget=0, label-free. 19 per-cell features: six rule indicators + rule score, conditional full/marginal/ratio, leave-one-out row aggregates, column cardinality/missing rate, column-kind one-hot. The signal layer sees no labels and is not refitted per evaluation split; the conditional features are scored out of fold over rows (5 seeded folds), so no cell's conditional score comes from a model that saw its row (in-sample instead: 0.5014 vs 0.6408 PR-AUC on breast_cancer). Only the meta-classifier is refitted per split. Rule features inherit the documented DatasetProfile soft-leakage caveat (CLAUDE.md §3).
